name: Clarity Over Resonance
desc:
Data Testing is Still in the Trial Phase, in the Future the Next Update May Lose Data!

This game contain Sound System


Make your own sound arrangement until it is really solid and clear,  Because if you are suddenly invited to battle sound with someone else, you might end up being covered up, meaning your sound is defeated and the sound becomes less powerful. So, make sure your sound arrangement is really good, so that does not cancel, and can perform optimally during the battle later!
